o.text: Morphologically dəyişmək (“to change”) + -dir. Cognate with Turkish değiştirmek.
Borrowed from Russian почта (počta), from Polish poczta, from Italian posta.
Internationalism. From Russian демократия (demokratija), ultimately from Ancient Greek δημοκρᾰτῐ́ᾱ (dēmokrătĭ́ā).
From bayğın (“unconscious”) + -lıq. Cognate with Turkish baygınlık.
Izafet II compound of pəncərə + alt. Calque of Russian подоко́нник (podokónnik)
